steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Good question: specific, debatable, evidence-based, manageable scope (not 'Why WWI?' but 'How far did German naval policy cause WWI?')

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Essay structure: intro (thesis + line of argument), themed paragraphs (PEEL), conclusion (judgement + significance)

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Evidence: select best, not all; deploy precisely (dates, stats, quotes); weigh (corroboration, provenance)

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Judgement: 'ultimately', 'more significantly', 'on balance'; avoid fence-sitting; relative significance

steps.title: Worked example
steps.body: Q: Write an essay introduction for: 'How far was economic crisis the main cause of the French Revolution?' --- Solution: The French Revolution (1789) resulted from a convergence of fiscal collapse, social tension, and Enlightenment ideas. While economic crisis -- state bankruptcy, grain shortages, regressive taxation -- provided the immediate catalyst, this essay argues that structural weaknesses of the Ancien Régime (privilege, absolutism, lack of representation) made revolution probable, with Enlightenment providing the intellectual framework. Economic crisis was the spark, not the fuel

steps.title: Try it yourself
steps.body: Formulate 3 enquiry questions on a topic | Plan a 45-min essay | Write a conclusion with nuanced judgement

steps.title: Lesson plan
steps.body: Starter (5 min): Recall prior knowledge of historical enquiry and essay skills with quick questions.
